classification.difficultyReason: Combine partial shares, percentage relationships and linked ratios before dividing the total.

content.prompt: Adam, Bertie, and Cameron are sharing \$240. Work out how much each person receives.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Bertie receives \$60. The ratio of Adam’s to Cameron’s shares are $4:5$.

answer.worked:
Adam and Cameron share the remaining money.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Remaining money}&=\$240-\$60\\&=\$180\\\text{Total parts}&=4+5=9\\\text{1 part}&=\$180\div9=\$20\\\text{Adam’s share}&=4\times\$20=\$80\\\text{Cameron’s share}&=5\times\$20=\$100\end{align*}$$
Bertie receives \$60.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Adam receives $\frac{1}{3}$ of the money. The ratio of Bertie to Cameron’s shares are $1:3$.

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Adam’s share}&=\frac{1}{3}\times\$240\\&=\$80\\\text{Remaining money}&=\$240-\$80\\&=\$160\\\text{Total remaining parts}&=1+3=4\\\text{1 part}&=\$160\div4=\$40\\\text{Bertie’s share}&=\$40\\\text{Cameron’s share}&=3\times\$40=\$120\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Cameron receives $20\%$ more money than Adam. The ratio of Adam to Bertie is $5:1$.

answer.worked:
Adam has 5 parts. Cameron has $20\%$ more, so Cameron has $5+\frac{20}{100}\times5=6$ parts. Thus Adam : Bertie : Cameron is $5:1:6$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total parts}&=5+1+6=12\\\text{1 part}&=\$240\div12=\$20\\\text{Adam’s share}&=5\times\$20=\$100\\\text{Bertie’s share}&=\$20\\\text{Cameron’s share}&=6\times\$20=\$120\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: The ratio of Adam to Bertie’s shares are $1:3$. The ratio of Bertie to Cameron’s shares are $1:2$.

answer.worked:
Match Bertie’s parts: Bertie : Cameron is $1:2=3:6$. Thus Adam : Bertie : Cameron is $1:3:6$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total parts}&=1+3+6=10\\\text{1 part}&=\$240\div10=\$24\\\text{Adam’s share}&=\$24\\\text{Bertie’s share}&=3\times\$24=\$72\\\text{Cameron’s share}&=6\times\$24=\$144\end{align*}$$
